paths.naming: Win32 winmain loads and saves %s.ini with CONFIG_NAME=scv through create_local_path.

The source persists signed integer joystick assignments. Negative values are Win32 virtual-key codes; nonnegative values encode joystick index in bits 5+ and one of 32 button/axis/HAT positions. eSCV's runtime consumes joystick indices 0..3.
For battery-backed cartridge type 1 (except Shogi Nyumon), MEMORY derives the save path from the selected cartridge and reads/writes 0x2000 bytes.
The Win32 state menu calls EMU::state_file_path, which formats CONFIG_NAME.sta<slot>; save_state writes compressed state when compress_state is enabled by default, and serializes VM/config state.
SCV MEMORY initializes its 0x1000-byte BIOS buffer and loads BIOS.ROM through create_local_path; absence leaves the initialized 0xff buffer.

paths.path: No separate key file; keyboard events are Win32 virtual-key codes in the process and optionally negative values in JoyButtonsEx/JoyToKeyButtons.
paths.naming: The Win32 joystick dialog stores -(LOBYTE(WM_KEYDOWN wParam)); no external key-material or key database is loaded by eSCV.

linux.reason: The official eSCV page says the emulator is for Win32 and requires Windows 10/11; no native Linux artifact or source build target was established.

linux-flatpak.reason: No first-party Flatpak or Linux artifact is published by the official eSCV distribution.

macos.reason: The official eSCV page identifies a Win32-only build requiring Windows 10/11; no macOS artifact was established.
